title: Amarnath Cave Temple

groundCutout.basis: A bounded reversible hole at the represented natural cave void. The original elevation field supplies the surrounding exposed valley and cliff slopes.

terrainReference.basis: Native height at the named cave mouth. The protected interior floor is interpreted below the exterior from published measurements.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap entrance and published government dimensions for Amarnath Cave Temple
mapIdentity.scope: The named and Wikidata-linked OpenStreetMap cave entrance fixes the shrine’s site by its mouth. The Divisional Commissioner records the aperture as about 40 yards wide and 75 feet high, with a descending recess about 80 feet deep.

note: Gangadhar Tambe’s cleared Qualla views establish the stepped shrine terrace, scalloped limestone aperture, roof fracture and seasonal interior ice pillar. The cave inventory independently describes the south-facing opening and the valley rock is reported as bedded limestone with thin shale and slate.
